notes.title: Update 2.0
notes.notes:
Hello there!

Update 2.0 improves the gallery! - Swapping out 1 of the static images for each character and bringing them to life with animation and voice acting. 

Any problems, let me know! 

Thank you.

notes.title: Update - 1.8
notes.notes:
Improved collisions, you should have a much more enjoyable time and be able to time your jumps better.

EDIT - You now also get 2 points per jump. This does not effect actual gallery unlocking as that is based on the time/distance you need to survive. So will effect leader board scoring. 

Thank you! :)
